timesformer_scroll5_july_retreat.architecture: TimeSformer small (dim 512, depth 8, heads 6, patch 16, 64 x 64 input, rotary frame embedding: the weights do not fix the frame count); villa model_timesformer.RegressionPLModel keys match exactly; with_norm False

production.render: vc_render_tifxyz num-slices 33, flip-normals true, scale 1, voxel 7.91 um
production.ink: start-layer 3, end-layer 30, tile 64, stride 16, force-reverse false, image ink-detection:v42

input_spec.voxel_um: 7.91 in production (registry range 7-10 um); DEV renders 9.362 um (inside range)
input_spec.slices: 27 centred on the surface: offsets -13..+13 (render indices 2..28 of 31)
input_spec.centring: surface = centre slice of an odd-count vc_render_tifxyz stack (production 33 -> layers 3..29; devloop 31 -> 2..28)
input_spec.order: forward = increasing vc_render_tifxyz --flip-normals index (production: flip-normals true, force-reverse false)

normalisation.primary: clip 0..200 then /200 (villa ink-detection/optimized_inference inference.py: np.clip(tile, 0, 200); A.ToFloat(max_value=200)); this is the production path
normalisation.training_code: clip 0..200 then /255 (villa deprecated train_timesformer_og.py: A.Normalize(mean=0, std=1), max_pixel_value default 255)
normalisation.discrepancy: production inference scales inputs 255/200 = 1.275 x the training-code scaling; the screen uses the production path unchanged (not chosen from any DEV result)

input_spec.tiling: tile 64, stride 16, Hann-window overlap-add, sigmoid, 4 x 4 logits bilinear-resized to 64 x 64; pixels covered only by Hann-zero tile borders (outermost canvas row/column) come out 0; all-zero tiles skipped
input_spec.in_plane_orientation: no rotation or flip applied by the official code (tiles are square; model is not rotation-equivariant by construction); render canvas used as is
input_spec.alt_window: TRAIN26 offsets -15..+10 (deprecated training code); available as --window alt

fiber_ink_4class_selfdistill.screen_status: SPEC-MISMATCH for the 9 um render screen: its documented input is a 2.4 um CT volume, not a 9.362 um flattened render. No render wrapper was built (it would be off-spec on voxel size (3.9 x) and geometry). A spec-conformant route (run on the DEV scroll 2.4 um volume around the organizer 2.4 um mesh, then project class-3 probability onto the 9 um canvas) needs a new declaration by the orchestrator; per-patch cost is in fiber_smoke.
smoke_notes: 256^3 forward (the documented patch size) was killed by the container memory cgroup (anon-rss 14.0 GB of ~15 GB; runs.jsonl smoke_fiber_fp32_b exit 137); 128^3 runs in 5.6 s at 4 threads fp32 (smoke_fiber_fp32_c). A 256^3 route needs sliding 128^3 inference or a larger machine; that is outside the documented spec and is not chosen here.
first attempt (smoke_fiber_fp32) failed on a float64 input: the smoke script omitted the float32 cast that dataset.py applies after normalisation; fixed to match dataset.py
fiber_ink_4class_selfdistill.cost_rough: route B only, not built: a 2 x 2 cm window at 2.4 um is ~8333^2 px; with ~128 voxels of depth around the sheet and 128^3 patches without overlap that is ~(8333/128)^2 = ~4240 patches x 5.6 s = ~6.6 CPU-hours per window before overlap or volume download; indicative only
